title: Unit Event — Dear Me, From Back Then — Episode1 Just Before Our Solo Show!

meta.Episode: Episode1 — Just Before Our Solo Show!
meta.Event Outline: The time has finally arrived for the first solo show of MORE MORE JUMP! Minori still can't seem to shake her nerves, but is reminded of the time she saw an ASRUN show for the first time after Haruka tells Minori a story about her own past...

rows.Line: Rental Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
And that is our plan for the day of.
Are there any questions or concerns that you think we should address?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't have any questions. What about the rest of you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm okay too!
Our fans should be able to enjoy everything as long as we follow this plan!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I agree.
And since we have arranged enough people to handle the merchandise, I think I'm good.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Then, I believe that concludes our final meeting before your solo show. I'll be looking forward to seeing you all again on the day!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: We look forward to seeing you too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I still can't believe this is all really happening...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me neither. After our training camp and designing our merch, we've been working so tirelessly for this that I'm getting kind of emotional.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
We put in so much time and effort... And now, our show's only a week away.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm so nervous!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's understandable since this is your very first solo show, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I'm really glad we haven't run into any serious problems and that it's actually happening.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. And we owe you quite a lot for gathering staff who can set up and run everything, Saito.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you very much for doing all this.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Shizuku just thanked me! To be able to receive such words makes me so happy! No, wait, I'm not worthy of such kindness...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess that part of you is never gonna change, huh?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: If anything, I should be thanking all of you for giving me such a wonderful opportunity that ties directly into what I want to do for a living!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: For a living?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes. I recall telling you all before about how I've been working part-time for a production company while attending university...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: After helping put on your last event, I've decided that I want to assist and support idols for a living...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our last event...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Do you mean our Christmas Fan Event?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Yes, that one!
I was already very interested in this line of work...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But I ended up having so much fun that I found myself wanting to do this for a living.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: It felt like I played an actual role in helping spread hope to others like all of you. That made me feel so happy...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And that's what made me want to learn more about this industry! That's why I also began studying how to become a talent manager while really trying to get the most out of my current job!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wow...!
That's so wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Our event helped cultivate her dream...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wait, this reminds me of...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's so heartwarming.
Your words mean a lot to us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... Y-Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We'll be rooting for you.
Also, feel free to ask if you ever need any help!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I really appreciate it!
Hearing you say that fills me with so much excitement!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: So, let's make your solo show a big success!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I promise to run a smooth operation with the staff so that you can all focus on putting on a great performance!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, if you're willing to give us that kind of guarantee, then we have no choice but to respond accordingly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our very first solo show as MORE MORE JUMP!... Obviously, it's a big deal for our fans, but it means just as much to us and the staff...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, let's do our best to make it the best show ever! One that everyone there is gonna enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow...!
You've really got this dance routine down!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And there's just one week left until your solo show, yes? It should go splendidly if you're all in this good of a condition!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We believe in you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
J-Just one more week...
I have to keep trying my best...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You still seem pretty nervous, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, she's been this way for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I can't help it!
I mean, it's just around the corner! How am I not supposed to feel nervous?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Based on how you're behaving, Minori, it really does feel like your time has finally come!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I believe that there's no need for you to worry so much.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You've practiced very hard, had a successful training camp and did everything else you could together.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: On top of all that, you've become quite the performer, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, I have?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
Not just you, Minori. You've all improved so much. So, the only thing left is for you to give the best performance you possibly can while on stage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for that, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
With regards to you, Minori...
We all agree with every word they just said.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... I know we practiced lots and lots until today, but I can't shake this feeling for some reason, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess it can't be helped.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It is her very first solo show after all. It's only natural to feel a mix of nervousness and excitement.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, Shizuku, did you also feel the same way?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel like everyone goes through this. Doing your first solo show is a pretty big milestone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I remember also feeling really nervous...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You too, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But to be fair, I didn't fully understand the power of a solo show until the day it happened.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The power of a solo show...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: After ASRUN released its debut single, we mainly performed in shows alongside other groups.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we were suddenly told that we'd be doing our first solo show... That really took me by surprise...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I thought that it wouldn't be any different from doing a show with another group. I didn't feel nervous at all since I believed that I just had to keep spreading hope to others like before...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, when we took the stage that day...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, get ready for the very first song of our solo show! We hope you all enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They're roaring... That never happened during our other shows.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Now I understand...
They all came here today to see us perform. Just ASRUN and ASRUN alone.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And they're waving their glow sticks around in unison. It's like they rehearsed what to do beforehand...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's so beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line: Haruka!!

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Fans
rows.Line: I've been dreaming of this day for so long! Thank you for doing this solo show!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Wow..
They're really here just to see us.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I can tell by their expressions just how much they've been looking forward to this show. They're cheering just for us.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That means I need to give it absolutely everything I have. This is what they've been waiting for...)
se_event_then_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This is so much fun.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They're clapping... But not to our performance... It's like we're singing and dancing to their beat.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Us, the audience... We're becoming one... I've never experienced anything like this before...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Now I see...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They all truly want to see us perform, and we're forging a deep bond as a result. No wonder it feels so different from when we performed alongside other groups...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This is it...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This is what it means to do a solo show.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That was how my first solo show went.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It felt really special...
And I want you to experience that incredible sensation, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Forging a deep bond with our fans...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That reminds me of the time when...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Man, I wish we could somehow see your solo show in person.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I feel the same way.
Unfortunately, that may prove a bit difficult...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, we've got you covered there.
We're gonna make some space for all of you at the front.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
What if people see us...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You'll be able to stay hidden because of all the equipment that's going to be around there. We're pretty sure nobody will see you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, that comes at the cost of not being able to see much else other than the stage. Still, I hope you enjoy our little VIP section.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow! Thank you, girls...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We promise to cheer for you like there's no tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I know you're nervous, Minori, but please try to enjoy your very first solo show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right!
I really appreciate it, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm gonna do the best I can!
I really wanna make the most of my first solo show since I only get one chance to perform in it!
